Heavy rains cause flash floods and landslides in Jammu, killing at least 11

Heavy rainfall has led to flash floods and landslides in the Poonch and Rajouri districts of Jammu, resulting in the deaths of at least 11 people. The deluge has devastated the region, with reports of injuries and missing persons. Authorities have stated that the administration is fully engaged in rescue operations in the affected areas.
